outcome: profile of pregnant women with hypertensive syndrome
cohort: The study included 468 medical records of pregnant women who underwent cesarean section at the Maternidade Dr. Peregrino Filho in Patos/PB, Brazil, between January 2008 and December 2012
finding: The study found that mild pre-eclampsia was the most diagnosed hypertensive disorder, and it was most prevalent in women aged 19-25 years, single, living in urban areas, brown-skinned, and between 35-40 weeks of gestation.
